transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, my carbon monoxide detector keeps going off and I’ve had a mild headache all morning. I’m in Yonkers, my zip code is 10701.

Carbon monoxide is dangerous, so please get everyone out into fresh air right now, and leave the door open behind you. Once you're outside, call nine-one-one, especially if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea. Don't go back in until the fire department says it's safe.
Okay, I'm going outside now. Thank you. Goodbye.
Thank you for your quick action. Stay safe and call nine-one-one once you're outside. Goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, and did not repeat questions or use jargon; it focused on one thing at a time and gave safe advice without inventing facts or promises.
